attachments.name: 24-3044 Subgrant Agreement - The Children's Partnership - #SG2024025 - Department of Health Care Services - Oakland Technical High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $945,805 grant for a student peer-to-peer mental health pilot at Oakland Tech

money.evidence: a grant in the amount of $945,805.00

enrichment.summary: Oakland Technical High School would accept a $945,805 grant through The Children’s Partnership, working with the California Department of Health Care Services. The money pays for a pilot project in which students support each other's mental health. The agreement runs from August 9, 2024 through June 30, 2027.

items.fundingSource: The Children’s Partnership Grant via the Department of Health Care Services
